llm.title: Vegeta: A Prince's Journey Beyond Power
llm.description: Explore the untold struggles and personal growth of Vegeta, the Saiyan Prince, as he navigates the balance between pride and humility.

scenes.description: On a distant planet, a lone warrior stands amidst ruins, pondering his past battles and relentless pursuit of power.
scenes.visual_prompt: A solitary figure of Vegeta standing on a rocky outcrop, overlooking a barren alien landscape under a crimson sky. His silhouette is strong and defiant, casting a long shadow. Low-angle view, evening red glow, with dynamic clouds swirling; --sref 2611275237 --ar 9:16
scenes.video_prompt: Vegeta's silhouette against a desolate alien backdrop, the camera zooms in on his determined expression as the wind rustles his battle-worn armor.

scenes.description: Vegeta reflects on the challenges that have shaped him, realizing the true essence of strength lies not in power alone but in the courage to change.
scenes.visual_prompt: A close-up of Vegeta's face as he stares into the distance, eyes filled with resolve and introspection. The golden hour lighting bathes his features in a warm, soft glow. Eye-level view, capturing the inner conflict and growth; --sref 2611275237 --ar 9:16
scenes.video_prompt: A tight shot of Vegeta's thoughtful expression, the camera slowly pulling out to reveal the vastness of the universe stretching out before him, symbolizing endless possibilities.

music.title: Beyond the Horizon
music.prompt: Epic orchestral score with powerful strings, soaring brass, and poignant piano motifs, capturing the essence of a hero's journey and inner transformation.
music.lyrics: In the vast expanse of stars we stride, A prince's heart, his strength, his pride. Through battles fierce, and nights so long, He finds his place where souls belong.
